tool_input.description: Test String.split behavior for edge case
Prepare scratch directory outside project tree

result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/LocaleUtilsAgentTest.java` with 35 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering `LocaleUtils`: available locale list/set (including immutability and caching), `countriesByLanguage`/`languagesByCountry` (null, known, unknown), `isAvailableLocale`, `isLanguageUndetermined`, `localeLookupList` (null, single-arg, two-arg with/without duplicate default), `toLocale(Locale)`, and extensive `toLocale(String)` coverage of valid formats (underscore/dash separators, numeric area codes, variants, country-only, JDK special cases for Thai/Japanese) and invalid formats (too short, bad case, missing/mismatched separators, empty variant). All 35 pass via `./_tools/test.sh`, and the full `*AgentTest` suite still passes.
